label: 3. Although I don't exactly trust your tastes,

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Although I don't exactly trust your tastes,

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: but there's no one else I can approach with this.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Which color do you think suits me best?
Are you going to dye your hair?

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: No, guess again.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: My hair is perfectly fine as it is,

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: and I have no intention of changing it.
Then why did you ask...?

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: I want to get a manicure.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Now, can you please just tell me the color?
Pink.
Azure blue.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Pink...

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: It's rather old hat...

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Do you really think pink suits me?
It'll match the color of your clothes.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Pfft, that's something all girls have heard a million times.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Azure blue...

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: That's an unexpected color.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: What makes you think azure blue will look good on me?
I think you can really make a statement with it.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: You sure it won't stand out too much?

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Very well, I'll consider it.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Either way, I'll let you know when it's done.
Looking forward to the end results.
